data.name: apache/groovy-geb
data.enhanced_text:
Apache Geb: Very Groovy Browser Automation.

Geb (pronounced “jeb”) is a browser automation solution. It brings together the power of WebDriver, the elegance of jQuery content selection, the robustness of Page Object modelling and the expressiveness of the Groovy language.
For more information about the project, see the https://groovy.apache.org/geb/.
Please see CONTRIBUTING.md for contribution guidelines.
If you'd like to submit an issue against Geb then please use the Geb GitHub issue tracker.
Please avoid submitting usage questions as issues
and instead join and ask your question on one of the following forums:

Export pinned Arc Browser tabs for importing bookmarks into other browsers.

## Installation
1. Clone the repository:
2. Navigate to the project folder:
Run the  script from the command line:
If you encounter any problems, manually copy the  file from the  directory to the project's directory and run the script again.

## Overview
This project provides a script for converting pinned tabs in the **Arc Browser** to standard HTML bookmarks file. These bookmarks can then be imported into any web browser.
This addresses the lack of a pinned tabs export feature in Arc Browser.
